providers.title: The cotype-cotype characterization
providers.scope: Assume (P) and (MP) (Pisier; not proved in the programme). A nonzero real Banach space with the approximation property is K-convex if and only if it and its dual have finite cotype.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The decay theorem
providers.scope: Under the approximation property and finite cotype of the space and its dual, the Walsh norms of the identity tend to 0 and the space contains no uniform copies of l_1^n; proved in full in the course.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Duality of K-convexity
providers.scope: K(X*) = K(X): the Rademacher projection on L_2(X*) is the adjoint of the one on L_2(X).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: K-convex spaces contain no uniform l_1^n
providers.scope: K(l_1^(2^n)) >= sqrt(n/3), so a K-convex space does not contain the spaces l_1^n uniformly.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Walsh norms
providers.scope: Walsh norms lie between 2^(-n/2)|T| and |T|, are nonincreasing, invariant under amplification, and decay like 2^(-n/2) for each finite-rank operator.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Kahane's inequality
providers.scope: For Rademacher sums in a Banach space, the L_2 norm is at most 24 times the L_1 norm.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Moment lifts
providers.scope: Under fixed-length cotype bounds, bounded sign-indexed families with prescribed first moments exist.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Chebyshev polynomials
providers.scope: Coefficients of a polynomial of degree d in the Chebyshev basis are at most twice its sup norm on [-1,1], and |Q'(0)| <= d(d+1) times the sup norm.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A coefficient of binary rank two
providers.scope: An odd bounded function of a sign matrix whose row and column averages reproduce odd functions with large first-order coefficients has a Fourier coefficient of binary rank at least two, bounded below.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Pairs of frames
providers.scope: GL(n, F_2) acts transitively on pairs of frames with a prescribed pairing matrix.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Growth from a slow decrease
providers.scope: If w_(n-2m)(T) <= 2 w_n(T), then w_(2(n-2m))(T) >= c_1 w_n(T), with c_1 depending only on the cotype data.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uniform decay
providers.scope: Walsh norms of finite-rank operators and their norm limits decay to 0 at a rate depending only on fixed-length cotype bounds.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A compact domain
providers.scope: Every finite-dimensional subspace of X factors through an injective compact map J: G -> X with |J| <= 2 and c_m(G*) <= 12 c_m(X*).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Grothendieck pairs
providers.scope: Assume (P), (GMR), (FTJ). If (E, F) is a Grothendieck pair with F infinite-dimensional with the approximation property, then (E, l_2) is a Grothendieck pair.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
